latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 1,633,200,000 CAD from the yfinance-statements statements in MDA-TO.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (1,633,200,000/641,200,000)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 157,800,000 CAD divided by revenue 1,633,200,000 CAD, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 407,500,000 CAD divided by net income 108,500,000 CAD, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 407,500,000 CAD less capex 275,400,000 CAD, divided by revenue 1,633,200,000 CAD, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 259,100,000 CAD (total debt 411,100,000 less cash 152,000,000, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 298,400,000 CAD (operating income 157,800,000 plus depreciation 140,600,000 for the period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 6 (state MIDDLING) computed over yfinance-statements statements in MDA-TO.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 5,056,629,670.03 CAD from quality.derived.market_cap in MDA-TO.json, computed over yfinance-statements shares and price (statement and price currency both CAD, no mismatch).

price_to_sales.basis: Price-to-sales 3.0961: market capitalization 5,056,629,670.03 CAD divided by fiscal-year revenue 1,633,200,000 CAD for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 5315729670.03 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 132100000.0, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth, from MDA-TO.json quality.reverse_dcf.
